text: A股市场AI短剧概念股集体上涨，其中，新华传媒、上海电影10CM涨停，华策影视涨超6%，捷成股份涨超5%，芒果超媒涨超4%，国安股份、中文在线涨超3%。 消息面上，《参考消息》10月8日刊发香港《南华早报》网站报道《AI微短剧是中国下一波出口浪潮的试验案例》。在服务业领域，一场不易察觉的转变正在发生。今年前7个月，中国服务出口同比增长17.1%，其中个人文化和娱乐服务出口激增57.8%。中国服务贸易仍处于逆差状态，服务出口的体量远不足以替代制造业。不过，数字服务无需工厂、集装箱和港口即可在全球扩大规模。人工智能（AI）生成的微短剧是一个早期例证。
text_en: A-share AI short-drama concept stocks rose collectively, among which Xinhua Media and Shanghai Film hit the 10CM limit up, Huace Film & TV rose over 6%, Jebsen Shares rose over 5%, Mango Excellent Media rose over 4%, Guoan Shares and Chinese Online rose over 3%. In terms of news, Reference News published on October 8 a report from the Hong Kong South China Morning Post website titled "AI micro-dramas are a test case for China's next export wave." In the services sector, an imperceptible shift is taking place. In the first seven months of this year, China's services exports grew 17.1% year-on-year, with personal culture and entertainment services exports surging 57.8%. China's services trade remains in deficit, and the volume of services exports is far from enough to replace manufacturing. However, digital services can scale globally without factories, containers and ports. AI-generated micro-dramas are an early example.
